content.value: The vanilla [[item/minecraft:furnace|Furnace]] serves as the [[article/kiln|Kiln]]. It handles its assigned non-food heating and material-processing recipes. Cooking food belongs to the [[article/smoker|Smoker]] or [[article/campfire|Campfire]].

Select a discovered recipe, set a quantity, and load compatible input and fuel. Quantity controls loading a batch; the machine still processes its contents over time. [[item/minecraft:hopper|Hoppers]] and existing furnace automation continue to use the underlying inventory.
A recipe must have discovered ingredients before it appears in your list. Craftable and material search use your current player storage.

[[item/minecraft:ancient_debris|Ancient Debris]] drops [[item/minecraft:netherite_scrap|Netherite Scrap]] when mined with the correct tool without Silk Touch. Silk Touch preserves the block; break that block without Silk Touch to obtain scrap. It is not a smelting recipe.
